episodes.196537: A southward advancing cold front combined with just enough instability for a few showers to result in a 61 mph gust in Lewistown the evening of October 21.
episodes.197066: Isolated strong to marginally severe storms impacted portions of central and south central Kansas the night of October 21st. A couple storms produced dime to quarter sized hail near the Wichita and Hutchinson areas.

events.narrative: ASOS station KLWT measured a 62 mph gust associated with a shower and cold front.
The report of quarter sized hail was received from the public via social media.

A report of quarter-sized hail was relayed via broadcast media. The time is estimated by radar along with the nearby occurrence of dime sized hail that occurred at the Weather Forecast Office in Wichita at around the same time.
